profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Shipt
profile.summary: An entrepreneur, engineer, and nerd at heart, I seek to advocate for positive change across an organization by promoting clear technical strategies and architecture to strengthen both the short-term needs and long-term profitability of the company.  As a leader, I believe motivation comes from inspiration, mastery and autonomy, and that work can be entrepreneurial, challenging and inherently enjoyable given the correct adjustments to culture.  As a technical architect, I believe in balanced and fearless change that heavily factors company objectives, goals, and ROI.  I also believe in continuous delivery using small autonomous teams with in high-trust cultural environments to promote quality and get time to market.   Passionate about highly scalable saas programming, I enjoy coding side-projects and side-businesses and consistently engage in technical challenges to continually progress my personal skills.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal engineer building, designing, and architecting applications on the shopper side of Shipt.  Helping to create, promote, and build foundational components, patterns, and infrastructure to help multiply software implementation for the super-cool problem of last-mile delivery, logistics, and communication between shoppers/drivers and shipt customers.

positions.title: Co-Owner and Entrepreneur
positions.description: Fully built and continuously enhancing an online direct mail and social crowdfunding platform to raise money for our children's educational needs.   We're fully focused on educational fundraising because our school funding is abysmal in the United States and there needs to be some disruption there.   I designed, built, and deployed every aspect of this system from the frontend CSS to the backend APIs and data stores.    Entire application written in Ruby on Rails, fully embraces Web 2.0 functionality, and has a robust automated test suite (who else would ensure that kind of quality!).  System is currently accepting and processing 30,000 sponsors a month with growth continuing beyond that.

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.description: Helping to promote, build, and extend Sports Engine's services strategy through architecture, strategy, product vision, and platform enhancements.  As a member of the core architecture team, my emphasis is SOA, APIs, Serverless, authentication, scale, and foundational components to enable the build-out of common services to be used across all acquisitions, vendors, and other services throughout the company.  Approximately 70% of my time is building software infrastructure to multiply and enable our engineers to quickly develop services and products that work in a cohesive and consistent manner.   Primary contributor building our Feed, Team, and Alexa services which are indirectly or directly used by parents, guardians, coaches, and administrators.   Darned proud to work for an executive staff that constructively engages and supports this architectural evolution.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Primary role is a core member of the Architecture team as well as the platform group building infrastructure and foundational components for the various services and properties which comprise their best-in-class platform for sports organizations and national governing bodies to run their websites, tournaments, leagues, player registration and mobile applications.  Tech is primarily Ruby on Rails, Typescript/Javascript, Amazon Lambdas, AngularJS, Redis, ElasticSearch, MySql, and all the cool infrastructure tech we know we need for a modern AWS applications (API Gateway, Dynamo, CloudFormation, etc)

positions.title: Co-Owner and Developer
positions.description: This is an entrepreneurial endevor building Alexa Skills and Android applications for companies.    Built 'Kids Sing Along' and 'Kids Kazamo' Alexa skills for kids ages 4-7.  The Android application is a multi-tiered Java and Python game called Juke Box Hero which allows consumer to guess the artist when a song plays.  Consumers can then purchase the music they hear as MP3s.  Built all in-app commerce, communication and backend Python high score system running on Google Base, and rearchitected the front end to fit on all the various screens inherit in the Android ecosystem.

positions.title: Principal Engineer/Architect
positions.description: Purposefully switched role to Principal Engineer within the architecture group engaging in design, architecture and java/javascript development for Workfront's SaaS work management platform. Role involves technical leadership and execution, building and migrating the platform's SOA services footprint, and expanding scalability capabilities. Also providing architectural support for the Minneapolis office which now has 2 full scrum teams, PMs, and UX. Working primarily with Java, Javascript, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (netflix opensource libraries), Oracle, NoSQL DHTs (Redis, Hazelcast), AngularJS, Spring 3 & 4, JPA, REST, and the various modern support TDD technologies such as Karma/Mocha/Chai/Mockito, Spring MockMVC/MockServer. Kickn Sass baby.

positions.title: Senior Manager/Architect
positions.description: Managing engineers and engaging in software development and architecture for AtTask's multi-tenant SaaS Project and Resource management platform.   Starting the Minneapolis office, hiring engineers, leading and engaging in software development using Java, continuous integration, Kanban.  This company's engineers are the most productive and efficient I've encountered in my entire career.  Kickn SaaS.  Takin Names.

positions.title: Senior Director of Development, Enterprise Commerce
positions.description: Worked exclusively on the enterprise eCommerce system from its inception in 2001.   Senior software engineer for 3 years, Technical Development Manager for 2 years for Integration Services group, Associate Director of gC Integration Services for 2 years, Director gC Integration Services 2 years, Senior Director of Development for Enterprise Commerce 3.5 years now.  All Java and internet technologies.  Continued role as solution architect and commerce system expert for APIs into and out of DR's enterprise commerce system.  Currently a key contributor for Strategy and emerging technologies for the company.  Key inventor for Patents #11694925 - Shopping Cart Service and Method,  #8190493 - Half-Graphical User Interface in a Order Processing system, and Transparent Commerce concept.

positions.title: Sole Proprietor
positions.description: Built both an online AJAX based web interface and a Java Micro Environment cell phone application to retrieve wind, wind forecasts, and other weather information.  Traditional 3 tier system with controller caching to reduce load on US aircraft weather system.    PHP, MySql, Java, J2ME.  Puppy screams with <1 second retrieval over the cell network.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Primarily acted as the internationalization and localization expert/engineer for the Personalization Engine.  Worked primarily on C++, Java, CORBA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on high-end card customization product.  Designed entire service oriented architecture for distributed card customization system (Itasca).   Drove enterprise product's internationalization and localization effort.   Designed and built entire audit control system for card  customization equipment.   All work in C++, XML, CORBA.  Feature article published in C++ Report February 1998.  Published comprehensive OODB comparison analysis 1999.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Various positions at the Rochester Minnesota facility primarily in the Network and System Monitoring group for the AS/400 platform.   Named inventor on 4 patents and one exclusive technical disclosure.   Gained the internationalization and localization exposure here!   Early student of OO concepts and patterns and directly learned OO concepts from Marshal Cline.

projects.title: Undraper Serializer (https://github.com/rubesMN/undraper-serializer)
projects.description: A fast super-memory-efficient serializer for Ruby Objects. Not Draper, not called a decorator, just a semi-opinionated declarative json serialization, written in Ruby, fast, nested, and deeply selectable.  Written and maintained fully by myself.

projects.title: Astronomy mount driver for observatory-grade telescope mount for TheSkyX Professional
projects.description: Built an X2 Driver in C++ for iOptron's flagship observatory-grade mount the CEM120-EC2 using iOptron's V3 command set.  The driver's purpose is to allow users of TheSkyX Professional Software to control this mount for slewing, tracking, and high-end astrophotography imaging.   This driver is written to support OSX, Linux, Rasberry Pi, and even Windows.  I implemented every possible feature including some mathematically complex slewing which allows an imager to delay a soon-to-be meridian flip based on coordinates and proximity to the meridian.   This is distributed under the RTI-Zone brand of astronomy drivers.

publications.title: Templatized Managed/Smart Pointers: A lesson in Restraint
Automatic Configuration Determination During Hardware Upgrades

patents.title: Shopping Cart Service System and Method
patents.description: A set of web services is provided that allow a client application to display product information from a site catalog, add/update/delete those products into a shopping cart hosted on the client, and have that shopping cart also maintained at a central hosted site. As such, the user is directed to the central hosted site in order to complete payment and fulfillment of the order. Several companies desire this functionality. As such, a set of shopping cart application programming interface (API) can be built and used to access product information and prices as well as to add or remove products from the shopping cart to which the consumer will be redirected upon finalizing the purchase. These processes are conducted in real time.

patents.title: Half-Graphical User Interface Order Processing System
patents.description: A half-graphical user interface (Half-GUI) order processing (HGOP) system with single sign on and its method of use is described. A set of web services may be utilized for order processing in an electronic commerce system which allows a merchant to host a product catalog and shopping cart, but post the transaction to an e-commerce system in one simple transaction. In response to a shopping cart request and utilizing single sign on technology, the HGOP system exposes a single checkout form, prepopulated with customer account information to a merchant web site. If no edits are required, the transaction posts and an order confirmation/thank you page is displayed. If edits are required or a new customer account is required, the customer's account is updated or created.
